notes.subject: עורה … עורה … אעירה
notes.rationale: Triple repetition of the same root 'wake' — poet wakes himself with the same verb he casts at his instruments.

notes.subject: אעירה שחר
notes.rationale: 'I will awaken the dawn' (dawn as object) vs traditional 'I will awake early'; JPS/BSB keep the object reading, KJV/ASV read it adverbially.

notes.subject: Kirap, glori bilong mi
notes.rationale: String of imperatives summoning the poet's own glory and his instruments to wake.

translation: Kirap, glori bilong mi; kirap, nevel na kinor; bai mi kirapim ⟨i⟩ taim san i kamap.
